description: SAT unique winner — 6 dims, weights [5,5,5,5,15,5]. Dim 4 (mobile) is architecturally locked: no competitor response can ever cover it. Only 'mobile' move covers dim 4 (the high-value dim). Therefore 'mobile' is the unique durable move; coaching/warehouse/no_op all get killed.
_solver_note: Z3 with manual skolemization (Template 8). For each candidate move, build a separate Solver with that move forced and ALL competitor response combinations enumerated. SAT under all responses = durable. Unsat under any response = killed. Dim 4 weight=15 makes it the swing dim; only 'mobile' delta touches it; no competitor response delta touches it → 'mobile' wins the moat.
